rationale: The stock gapped up ~26% on strong earnings but is now trading at 16% of today's range, well below VWAP ($170.24) and the 9-EMA ($167.61), suggesting the gap is fading and sellers are in control intraday. However, the broad market is under significant stress (SPY -1.67%, VIXY +10.48%), making directional conviction difficult — a long risks further gap-fill while a short risks a snap-back given the fundamental catalyst. The wide bid-ask spread (76.7 bps) and volatile 1-minute candles (swings of $3+ per bar) add execution risk that makes the risk/reward unattractive in either direction at this moment.
